keto.note: a strict way of eating - check with a doctor first if you have a health condition
rules: At least 400 g of vegetables and fruit a day (potatoes do not count)
No bread, pasta, rice, potatoes, cereals or sugar
Leafy greens, cabbage, courgettes, peppers or other non-starchy vegetables at lunch and dinner every day
A protein food (meat, fish, eggs or cheese) at every meal
Fatty fish at least 2 times a week
Olive oil, butter, avocado, nuts or seeds every day
Fruit only as a small portion of berries, at most 3 times a week
No sweet drinks and no fruit juice
